title: What If a Mirror Was Off by a Fiftieth of a Hair? Hubble's Was

scenes.text: What if a mirror was wrong by one fiftieth of a human hair? Hubble's was.
Hubble launched in 1990 with a main mirror flattened by about two microns.
That tiny error made the pictures blurry, because light never focused to a single point.
For about three and a half years, Hubble's images stayed blurry.
In December 1993, astronauts spent 35 hours and 28 minutes on five spacewalks installing corrective optics.
A phone booth sized unit called COSTAR worked like eyeglasses, and Hubble finally saw sharp.

description:
What if a mirror was wrong by one fiftieth of a human hair?
